TEXT:
After taking a gander at Kinkaku-ji Temple, Manami 
and I made our way to the Studio Park.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Wow, there sure are a lot of people here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: They're all tourists, like us. Oh, right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Please wait for a bit. I'm going to change my 
clothes.

With that, she jogged over to a nearby building. I 
bet she's getting herself dressed in those feudal-era 
costumes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Watch your step~

After the brief reminder, I patiently awaited her 
return.
Several minutes later.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, sorry to make you wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, that was... nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: H-How do I look?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why a Town Girl costume?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I-Is it strange? I've been wanting to try this on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, it's not strange at all. In fact, it really suits you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? Ehehe, I'm so happy.

Didn't expect the costume to fit her so well, in 
more ways than one... There's no underestimating 
her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Yeah, you're probably the most well-dressed out of 
everyone here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Oh, you're just exaggerating... Ehehe, I got praised 
by Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm just being honest. This suits you way better 
than some princess cosplay.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Thank you, Kyou-chan. But, even if you say things 
like that, I can't give you anything in return...

She says that, but she's sticking her hand out to me. 
Probably wants the point card.
Can't give anything? What's this, then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you for your patronage.①

While I might be interested in the rewards, the 
process of collecting points is fun in its own way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Seriously though... that really looks good on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Oh yeah! Since you're cosplaying like a town girl, 
maybe you could do "that"!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh? What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That thing the evil magistrates always do.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Ah, you mean when they go "It's fine, isn't it?", then 
they spin the girls around by pulling the sash?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmm, I think I'd get pretty dizzy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Wanna give it a go?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh?  But, it's not very safe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Um, Kyou-chan? Why do you look so disappointed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not... disappointed at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ah, you know, speaking of this cosplay, I think the 
old you will be better suited for it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I mean, you were really plain back then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I bet if that happens, you will blend into the 
background, no one would notice you at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, you're so mean. Boo...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I told you not to act like that... Oh, never mind. Shall 
we have a look around?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yup, let's go.
And with that, we went around the Studio Park.
